title: PlayerBucket
description: So i found the VillagerinBucket plugin an thought "Wouldn't it be cool to put players in buckets?"so here i am with a plugin that lets YOU kidnap you're friends:)
body:
# **Here are all the features**
- Catch players in buckets 
- while fighting bucket pvp is disabled
Here are the edge cases:
- if the player is thrown in lava while in bucket the player is released and tped to 
  a save place
#    **Edge cases**
- if bucket with player is about to despawn the player is released
- same thing if the chunk is unloaded

- and thats pretty much it,I will continue to make more plugin loader support and diffrent version support.

**_Please give this plugin a like it really helps and make sure to give tips in the report link THANK YOU IN ADVANCE!!!_**
